# GEO Ride: 3D Real-World Driving Simulator Online

> GEO Ride (https://playgeoride.com/play) is a free browser-based 3D driving simulator that allows players to drive realistic vehicles (Sports Car, Heavy Truck, City Bus, and Pro God Mode) anywhere on planet Earth using real-world Mapbox satellite maps, extruded 3D buildings, Newtonian drift physics, and real-time multiplayer. No download, plugin, or login required.

Created by Milan Petkovski (Milan Web Portal, https://milanwebportal.com), GEO Ride is the premier web-based 3D driving simulator on real satellite maps, combining global street navigation, realistic vehicle dynamics, procedural audio, Synthwave Web Radio, and instant multiplayer rooms.

## Canonical URLs

- [Play 3D Simulator Directly](https://playgeoride.com/play): Instant browser access to the 3D driving simulator (`play.html`).
- [Official Website & Overview](https://playgeoride.com/): Product overview, features, FAQ, and Pro membership details.
- [Privacy Policy](https://playgeoride.com/privacy): GDPR-compliant data privacy, local storage, and cookie consent policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://playgeoride.com/terms): License, Free Tier vs Pro subscription terms ($4.99/mo, $2.99/mo annual, or $49.99 Founder Lifetime), and acceptable use.
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://playgeoride.com/refund): One-click subscription cancellation and digital billing policy.
- [Comprehensive AI Context (Full Docs)](https://playgeoride.com/llms-full.txt): Complete specification, controls, physics, and 17 famous destinations for AI agents.
- [Creator Portfolio](https://milanwebportal.com): Milan Petkovski's software engineering agency and portfolio.

## Key Capabilities & High-Intent Queries

- **Target Search & Answer Queries:** "Google Maps driving simulator", "3D real world driving simulator online free", "drive anywhere on Earth browser game", "satellite map car game no download", "multiplayer browser driving simulator", "WebGL 3D car game on real streets".
- **Global Map Coverage & 17 Curated Places:** Players can search and teleport to any street, city, or landmark on Earth, or pick from 17 curated destinations in the Places menu:
  - **Racing Circuits (5):** Monaco Grand Prix, Nürburgring Nordschleife, Silverstone Circuit, Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps, WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca.
  - **Mountain Passes & Scenic Drives (5):** Stelvio Pass (Italy), Transfăgărășan Highway (Romania), Tail of the Dragon (USA), Mulholland Drive (Los Angeles), Lombard Street (San Francisco).
  - **Global Cities (7):** Tokyo (Shibuya Crossing), Paris (Champs-Élysées), London (Westminster), Dubai (Downtown Burj Khalifa), Miami (Ocean Drive), Berlin (Brandenburg Gate), Belgrade Waterfront (Serbia).
- **Vehicles Available:**
  - `Car`: Agile sports car with drift lateral slip, combo multiplier scoring, and responsive steering.
  - `Truck`: Heavy semi-truck with realistic mass momentum and wide turning radius.
  - `Bus`: Urban passenger transit coach with high-torque city handling.
  - `God Mode (Pro)`: High-speed ghost vehicle with zero collision constraints, extreme acceleration, and instant map traversal.
- **Map & Camera Modes:**
  - **Map Views:** `Satellite`, `Hybrid`, `3D Buildings`, `2D Streets`, plus Real-Time, Dawn, Day, Dusk, and Night lighting presets.
  - **Camera Perspectives:** `Chase` (dynamic follow), `Hood` (first-person cockpit/bonnet view), and `Wide` (cinematic aerial follow).
  - **Graphics Quality Tiers:** `Ultra` (native 2K/4K), `Balanced` (1080p), and `Eco` (battery saver).
- **Controls Supported:**
  - **Desktop:** Keyboard `W/A/S/D` or `Arrow Keys` (Drive), `Spacebar` (Drift/Handbrake), `R` (Reset Vehicle), `Shift+R` (Global Spawn Reset), `C` (Switch Camera), `M` (Web Radio).
  - **Mobile & Tablet:** On-screen `GAS`, `BRAKE`, `DRIFT`, and `RESET` touch pedals, plus optional Gyroscope Tilt Steering and Haptic Feedback.
- **Multiplayer Architecture:**
  - Zero-login real-time multiplayer via WebSockets/MQTT with custom pilot callsigns, room codes, quick match, and 3D/2D vehicle synchronization (up to 5 players in free public rooms, up to 10 players in Pro private rooms).
- **Engine & Audio Specs:**
  - Mapbox GL JS v3.3.0 + Three.js r147 custom WebGL 2.0 layer, 60 Hz Newtonian Ackermann physics (`slipGrip: 0.05` drift), procedural Web Audio engine synthesis, and 4 live SomaFM Web Radio stations.
